p1.1: In San Francisco, nineteen seventy-four, men start turning up dead near Ocean Beach.
p1.6: By September, nineteen seventy-five, at least five men are dead.
p1.9: In nineteen seventy-six, police question a strong suspect.
p1.12: In twenty twenty-three, police release a new, age-progressed sketch.
p1.13: The reward is raised, to two hundred and fifty thousand dollars.
